cases.name: Crystal Rasch
cases.narrative:
His defense has conceded that he disposed of Crystal body, but denied that he had any involvement in her death, suggesting that Crystal took her own life while handling her husband’s gun in his car. When officers searched the couple’s property, they found multiple burn areas, and in one they found a tooth and fragment of skull known as the “Petrus Pyramid.” The tooth matched Crystal dental records and the skull fragment matched her DNA.

Detectives who searched his vehicle said a seatbelt, the front passenger seat and front passenger door were saturated with blood and it “looked like someone had tried to clean, but not nearly well enough.” The DNA was a match to Crystal.
